highlights: Health and Safety School award from the Ministry of Labour
Systematic protocol for infection control and disease prevention
Student food allergy list and colour-coded wristbands
Partnerships with affiliated hospitals for emergency care and referrals
safety.policy_summary: The school emphasizes student health and safety through an on-site infirmary with registered nurses, systematic infection control protocols, and close communication regarding student allergies. Counselling services support overall well-being alongside medical provisions.
